async def act(page):
    """Make the product out of stock by opening the Inventory tab, setting Stock Availability to Out of Stock, and saving.
    Assumes we are already on the product edit page for Taurus Elements Shell.
    """
    # Click the Inventory tab in the left/product tabs
    # The link's accessible name includes the word 'Inventory', so match by that substring.
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Inventory").click()

    # Wait for the Inventory content to appear by waiting for the Stock Availability combobox
    stock_availability = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Stock Availability")
    await stock_availability.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=5000)

    # Set Stock Availability to "Out of Stock"
    # Use select_option with a label dict to be explicit about selecting by visible option text.
    await stock_availability.select_option({"label": "Out of Stock"})

    # Save the product. This will typically trigger a navigation / reload.
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save").click()
